0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns, 0-1 after a road loss, host the Golden State Warriors, also 0-1, in Phoenix's second game of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix sits 5th in the Pacific and 15th in the West, one game back in its division, while Golden State is 3rd in the Pacific and 13th in the West, also one game back. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; Golden State is missing Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), and Moses Moody (out, knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in their most recent meeting, a 101-97 Phoenix loss on February 5, 2026, the Suns lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
